name: Pedro
blurb: Raffaella Carrà's "Pedro" in a 2024 remix, soundtrack of the spinning raccoon meme
title: Pedro Raccoon Song: The Jaxomy & Agatino Romero Remix Explained
description: The "Pedro" raccoon song is the 2024 remix of Raffaella Carrà's 1980 hit by Jaxomy and Agatino Romero, made famous by a TikTok clip of a dancing, spinning raccoon.
answer: The "Pedro" raccoon song is a 2024 techno remix by producers Jaxomy and Agatino Romero of "Pedro", a 1980 Italian disco hit by Raffaella Carrà; it is credited to all three. In March 2024 TikTok users paired it with a looping clip of a baby raccoon bobbing and spinning around the edge of a circular frame, and by April the "Pedro Pedro Pedro" raccoon was everywhere on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram.

body: The clip shows a baby raccoon filmed above a rotating camera: it bobs up and down and seems to wave a paw while travelling around the edge of a round frame. Set to the pounding remix and its repeated "Pedro, Pedro, Pedro", it looks like the raccoon is dancing to the beat.

body.note: The raccoon's real name is reportedly Ginger. The original clip, posted in September 2023 by TikTok user @fleksa30, used a different song; "Pedro" was added by other users months later.

head: Date
Event
rows: Raffaella Carrà releases "Pedro" on her album Mi spendo tutto.
@fleksa30 posts the spinning raccoon clip on TikTok, set to the Russian song "Kak Dela?".
Jaxomy and Agatino Romero release their remix of "Pedro".
A TikTok meme about loud car subwoofers pairs the raccoon with the remix; copies follow within days.
The raccoon meme goes global on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram, and the song climbs charts across Europe.

ul: Bass jokes: the raccoon "dancing" to show how hard a car or home subwoofer hits.
Green-screen edits that drop the spinning raccoon into other videos, games or classrooms.
Reaction clips: posting the raccoon when something good happens, like a mini victory dance.
Stickers and other fan merch of the raccoon.

body: It is often compared with CatJAM, the head-bobbing cat that does the same job: an animal that seems to vibe perfectly to the beat.

The remix reached No. 1 in Slovakia, No. 3 in Germany and Finland, No. 37 on the Billboard Global 200 and No. 57 in the UK, with multi-platinum certifications in several countries. The peak craze was spring and summer 2024; today "Pedro Pedro Pedro" is a well-known meme sound that still turns up whenever someone needs a silly dancing animal.

faq.q: Who sings the Pedro raccoon song?
faq.a: The vocals are Raffaella Carrà's from her 1980 song "Pedro". The 2024 remix is by Jaxomy and Agatino Romero and is credited to Jaxomy, Agatino Romero and Raffaella Carrà.
Yes. It is a real baby raccoon, reportedly named Ginger, filmed by a TikTok user; the spinning effect comes from the rotating camera.

faq.q: What language is Pedro sung in?
faq.a: Italian. The hook is simply the name Pedro repeated, which is why people everywhere can sing along.
